hero.kicker: Shiva as Vaidyanath · Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
beats: Ravana bore the lingam towards Lanka
Here it was set down forever
Two merchants raised it in stone, 1204

beats.line: Ravana did penance to Shiva on Kailash
On the way to Lanka, the lingam was set down
Two merchants raised a stone temple in 1204
Pilgrims pray to Shiva as Vaidyanath, the healer
